title: Vanishing Clutter: Fast and Accurate Shape Imaging via Active Cloaking
summary: Imaging a target sample in near-field scanning optical microscopy (NSOM) is fundamentally limited by measurement artifacts and data contamination from multiple probe-sample scattering. The probe, essential for subwavelength resolution, inherently perturbs the local field, degrading the signal-to-noise ratio and rendering the inverse problem for quantitative shape reconstruction highly ill-posed.
